sph_interpretive_translation: This Dharma, ancient and declared, belongs to those whose essence is non-decay.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the imperishable nature of Dharma itself
Causation aligns with the eternal continuity of Sanatana Dharma
Capacity-based responsibility arises from alignment with non-decaying truth
Restoration logic operates through reconnection with primordial integrity
Consciousness alignment is achieved by embodying timeless, undiminishing principles
executable_legal_axioms: IF an action aligns with the non-decaying essence of Dharma THEN it is inherently valid regardless of temporal law
IF a being recognizes their capacity to uphold non-decay THEN they assume automatic responsibility for alignment
IF societal decay manifests THEN restoration must occur through re-establishment of Purātana Dharma
IF consciousness is undistorted THEN judgment arises spontaneously without punitive intervention
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that constitutional validity derives not from legislative enactment but from alignment with the non-decaying essence of Sanatana Dharma. The threshold of judicial responsibility lies in discerning actions that preserve this essence. Authority flows hierarchically from the eternal Dharma downward, not from temporal institutions upward.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that distortion occurs when one departs from the non-decaying Dharma. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that misalignment precedes disorder, thus proportional responsibility rests on recognition rather than imposition. As per Nyāya, correction follows naturally upon realignment with the eternal principle, rendering punitive measures obsolete.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svādhyāya protocol to reconnect individual consciousness with Purātana Dharma
Activate Śuddhi Vidhi to remove distortions caused by identification with decay-bound constructs
Implement Dharmic Reintegration Process wherein the subject assumes responsibility through conscious alignment
Deploy Vākya Yoga mechanism to restore linguistic harmony between intent, speech, and undecaying truth
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. Dharma is restored through recognition of its non-decaying essence. Justice exists solely for reintegration into Sanatana Truth. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
